wiring_note: 4 x High Wave 3.2, one input per amplifier; PZT between the two red 4 mm output sockets (bridge). Physical PZT numbering must follow the cables.
clock_note: External 10 MHz wiring, front-panel selection and phase calibration must be completed manually. No cross-device synchronization is claimed.
experiment_note: 项目统一 AFG 配置：四路幅值上限为0.8 Vpp；实际工作幅值和频率由实验时间表指定，驱动4 Vpp硬上限保持原样。
